description: This file contains rendering functions for 3D boxes, including drawing faces and edges using OpenGL. It defines functions to render a box with specified width, height, depth, and color.

methods.name: void lu5_render_box_faces(lua_Number w,lua_Number h,lua_Number d,lu5_color color)
methods.description: Renders the faces of a 3D box with specified dimensions and color using OpenGL quads.

methods.name: void lu5_render_box_edges(lua_Number w,lua_Number h,lua_Number d,lu5_color color)
methods.description: Renders the edges of a 3D box with specified dimensions and color using OpenGL lines.
